title: Food Bank and Pantry Distribution
summary: Helps food banks, pantries and essentials closets turn stock counts and pickup bookings into restock lists and balanced pickup plans, while household decisions and messages stay with staff.

organizations.org_type: Volunteer-run food bank, pantry or essentials closet
organizations.serves: Households collecting food or essentials at set pickup times
organizations.mandate: Keep shelves stocked, hand out food before its quality date passes, and keep pickup lines short and fair

never: Decide which households get food, extra food or an exception
Message or call households or volunteers on the organization's behalf
Judge whether food is safe to eat from a date label alone

sources.title: Feeding America: How Do Food Banks Work?
